title: Review: fragment.rs 2026-08-16
description:
Review of rust/lichen-schc/src/fragment.rs focusing on edge cases.

## Summary
- P0: 0 findings
- P1: 3 findings (should fix)
- P2: 4 findings (worth fixing)
- P3: 2 findings (polish)

## Review confidence
Confidence: 85% chance of no missed critical bugs.

Least confident areas:
1. The bitmap compression/decompression logic in Ack::write_to and Ack::from_bytes is complex
2. The MIC failure recovery logic in finalize() has subtle edge cases
3. Multi-window scenarios (window > 0) have less test coverage in the visible tests

Would raise confidence if:
- More comprehensive property-based tests for bitmap encoding round-trips
- Test vectors from RFC 8724 appendix covering multi-window scenarios
- Fuzzing of the from_bytes parsers

## Positive findings
- Error handling is comprehensive with good use of early returns
- The code correctly uses saturating_sub() where underflow is possible (line 271)
- All public error types implement Display and Error traits properly
- Fragment serialization correctly validates invariants before writing
